name: RankX SEO – AI Product Descriptions, Meta & ALT Text for WooCommerce
author: rankxseo1

sections.description:
RankX SEO is the AI SEO plugin built for WooCommerce products, not blog posts. It writes product descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, image ALT text, FAQs and tags for your whole catalog, shows you a before/after preview, and then proves the result with your own Google Search Console data: where each product ranked before it was optimized, and where it ranks now.

Most SEO plugins give you a score and a checklist. RankX SEO does the work on every product page, and only writes to your store when you approve it (or when you turn on Auto mode yourself). Every change is backed up and can be undone in one click.

It works for any WooCommerce store, in the US, the UK, the Gulf or anywhere else, in English and native Arabic.

Why store owners choose RankX SEO

  • ✔ Made for products – product descriptions, meta, ALT text and FAQs for hundreds of products at once, plus category and brand pages.
  • ✔ Review before anything is written – a clear before/after for every product, with a backup and one-click undo.
  • ✔ Proof, not promises – SEO impact connects Google Search Console and Analytics and shows clicks, impressions, position and organic sales before and after each optimization, product by product.
  • ✔ Ready for AI search (AEO / GEO) – visible FAQ sections with FAQPage schema, direct-answer descriptions and llms.txt, so ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini and Perplexity can quote your products.
  • ✔ No API key to manage – no OpenAI account, no prompts to write. Connect your store and start with 10 free AI optimizations.
  • ✔ Works with Yoast SEO and Rank Math – writes into their own fields, or runs on its own.
  • ✔ Native Arabic, not machine-translated – RankX was built Arabic-first, so Arabic product content reads like a real Gulf copywriter wrote it.

AI product optimization

  • AI product description generator – SEO product descriptions with clear headings, benefits and specifications, written in your store’s language and voice.
  • Meta title and meta description – click-worthy, within Google’s length limits, written into Yoast SEO or Rank Math when they are active.
  • Target keyword mode – optimize a product for a keyword using live Google search data for it.
  • AEO mode – descriptions and FAQs written to be quoted by AI answers.
  • AI ALT text for product images – for every product image that is missing it.
  • Product FAQs with FAQPage schema – questions shoppers really ask, shown on the page and marked up for Google.
  • Product tags, categories and brands – descriptions, meta and FAQs for category and brand pages too.
  • Bulk optimization – select up to 1,000 products and let them run in the background, with a live progress bar.
  • Auto mode – improves new and incomplete products in the background, within the daily limit and run window you set, with a first-batch review.

Measure your SEO impact

  • Before/after for every product – Google position, clicks and impressions before and after each optimization, with a clear verdict and the next step.
  • Store dashboard – products in the top 5 and on page one, organic clicks and organic sales.
  • Rank tracking – weekly position checks for the keywords that matter to you.
  • Keyword research and competitor gap – search volume, difficulty and the keywords your competitors rank for.
  • AI visibility – check whether AI assistants mention your store.
  • SEO assistant – ask questions in plain words and get answers from your store’s own numbers.

Content and growth

  • AI blog writer – full articles for keywords people search, with a featured image and links to your products.
  • Store chatbot (optional, off by default) – answers your shoppers about your products, stock and your own shipping and returns policies.

Free local SEO tools (no account needed)

These run on your own hosting, are free without limits and need no account:

  • Image compression and WebP conversion, with backups and one-click restore
  • Product and category schema, Open Graph and canonical tags
  • Redirects (301/302/410) and 404 monitoring
  • Internal links and orphan products (products no page links to)
  • Out-of-stock handling
  • Site health, reports, alerts and a weekly email
  • SKU generator, FAQ import from CSV and manual FAQs
  • llms.txt, AI-crawler rules and noindex for system pages
  • Broken-link checks (opt-in)

How pricing works

Only the AI features use credits, because they run on the RankX service (content generation, research, audits, rank tracking, the assistant and the store chatbot). Connecting your store gives you 10 free optimizations. More credits can be bought from inside the plugin; payment is completed on rankxseo.com by secure online payment. Credits never expire. Nothing that runs on your own site uses credits.

  • كتابة وصف المنتجات بالذكاء الاصطناعي بعربية سليمة كأن كاتب محتوى خليجي كتبها، لا ترجمة آلية.
  • عنوان الميتا ووصف الميتا ضمن حدود جوجل، وتُكتب في حقول Yoast أو Rank Math إن كانت مفعّلة.
  • نص ALT للصور، والأسئلة الشائعة مع سكيما FAQPage، والوسوم، والأقسام والماركات.
  • تحسين بالجملة وتلقائي لكل الكتالوج، مع معاينة قبل/بعد ونسخة احتياطية وتراجع بضغطة.
  • أثر السيو الحقيقي: ترتيب كل منتج في جوجل ونقراته قبل التحسين وبعده من بيانات Search Console الخاصة بك.
  • جاهزة لإجابات الذكاء الاصطناعي (ChatGPT وAI Overviews وGemini) عبر الأسئلة الشائعة الظاهرة وllms.txt.
  • أدوات محلية مجانية بلا حساب: ضغط الصور وWebP، السكيما، التحويلات و404، الروابط الداخلية، مولّد SKU.

الواجهة بلغة لوحة كل مستخدم (عربي أو إنجليزي)، والمحتوى المولَّد بلغة متجرك. مع الربط تحصل على 10 تحسينات مجانية.

External services

This plugin connects to the following services. No request is made to any of them before you take the action described.

RankX API (rankxseo.com)

The RankX service generates the content and runs the analyses behind the AI features.

  • When: only after you connect your store (“Connect your store”), and then only when you use a feature that needs it (optimize, research, audit, blog writer, insights, SEO impact, assistant) or when you turn on a scheduled job yourself (Auto mode, weekly rank tracking, the weekly report’s balance check).
  • What is sent: when connecting — your site URL, site name and the email you enter. For each feature — the content it works on: product names, descriptions, short descriptions, categories, tags, regular prices, attributes and image URLs; category/brand names and descriptions; the keyword and market country you choose; your site URL and public page URLs for audits; the site language and the admin’s interface language. The store chatbot sends the shopper’s question, the short conversation history and matching product data. Your connection key is sent with every request.
  • Terms of use: https://rankxseo.com/en/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://rankxseo.com/en/privacy

Google (Search Console, Analytics)

Used by “SEO impact” to show clicks, impressions, position and organic sales before and after each optimization.

  • When: only if you click “Connect Search Console and Analytics”. You sign in with Google and grant read-only access; the connection is handled by the RankX service, and you can disconnect at any time.
  • What is read: Search Console performance data and Analytics reports for the property you select, for the pages RankX optimized.
  • Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

IndexNow (api.indexnow.org)

Tells search engines that support IndexNow (such as Bing) when a product, category or post is published or updated.

  • When: only if you turn on “IndexNow” in RankX SEO → Technical settings (off by default), and not when Rank Math already does it.
  • What is sent: the public URLs that changed, your site’s host name and the IndexNow key file URL.
  • Terms and documentation: https://www.indexnow.org/terms

Your own links (broken-link check)

The daily broken-link check is off by default. Only if you turn it on in Technical settings does your site send a HEAD request to the links found inside your product descriptions and posts, to see whether they still work. No site data is sent.

Payments

Buying credits or chatbot packs opens a checkout page on rankxseo.com; the plugin itself never talks to a payment provider. See the RankX terms and privacy policy above.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. In Plugins → Add New, search for “RankX SEO”, install and activate it (or upload the rankx-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/).
  3. Open the “RankX SEO” menu and click “Connect your store”. Nothing is sent to the RankX service before this step.
  4. Optimize a product, review the before/after, and approve it.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Is it free?

The local SEO tools listed above are free and run on your own hosting. AI features (writing and research) run on the RankX service and use credits; connecting your store gives you 10 free optimizations to start.

Do I need an OpenAI or ChatGPT API key?

No. RankX SEO runs the AI for you, so there is no API key, no model to choose and no prompt to write.

Can I generate product descriptions in bulk?

Yes. Select products (or every product that matches a filter, up to 1,000 at a time) and RankX SEO optimizes them in the background with a live progress bar. You can also turn on Auto mode to handle new and incomplete products every day.

Does it write image ALT text?

Yes. It writes ALT text for every product image that is missing it, describing what is actually in the image.

Will it help my products appear in ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews?

It prepares them for it: visible FAQ sections with FAQPage schema, descriptions that answer the question directly, llms.txt and AI-crawler rules. No tool can promise a mention, so SEO impact and AI visibility checks show you what actually changed.

How do I know the optimization worked?

Connect Google Search Console and Analytics in SEO impact. For every optimized product you see its position, clicks and impressions before and after, with a verdict and the next step.

Does it work in English and Arabic?

Yes. The interface follows each admin’s WordPress profile language (English or Arabic), and generated content follows your site’s language, so an English-speaking admin on an Arabic store still gets Arabic content. You can also pin the content language from the header.

What happens to my previous product content?

Before writing new content, the plugin backs up the previous description and meta fields to post meta (_rankx_backup) so it can be restored with one click. The backups are kept if you uninstall the plugin.

Does it work with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

Yes. If either plugin is active, RankX SEO writes the meta title/description and focus keyword into that plugin’s own fields and steps aside where they already output schema or redirects. If neither is active, RankX SEO outputs the meta tags itself.

Is anything written to my store without my approval?

No. Manual optimization always shows a before/after preview first. Auto mode only runs if you turn it on, and its first batch waits for your review.
